//: MCP controller config for Yaycay backing services. Verified working in the web env.
//creds: Provide the referenced env vars as SECRETS (env store), never inline.
//readonly: Supabase stays --read-only; drop the flag only for an explicitly write-approved project.
//supabase-features: Scoped to --features=database. The default set includes a docs group that fetches the Supabase Content API GraphQL schema at tools/list time, which this env egress blocks (403). Re-add docs only if content-api egress is opened.
//stripe-version: Pinned to @stripe/mcp@0.2.5 which runs tools locally against api.stripe.com. @0.3.x proxies to the hosted mcp.stripe.com, which this env egress blocks (403). Use latest only if mcp.stripe.com is opened.
